page.title: Permission Rules
page.subtitle: Per-user rules that restrict tools and MCP servers or override persona, model, native execution and global memory (default config profile).

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first enabled rule whose conditions match the sender wins. Senders matched by no rule get the default (unrestricted) policy.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Everyone uses the default policy.
rules.name: Name

match.syntaxTitle: Match condition syntax (a rule matches when any of its conditions matches):
match.syntaxSender: that sender anywhere (private or group chats)
match.label: Match conditions
match.hint: Press Enter, space or comma after each condition: 123456/7890, p_7890, g_123456, role:admin, role:member, *
match.errorRole: "{condition}": role must be admin or member
match.errorSyntax: "{condition}" is not a valid condition and will never match
match.errorNone: This rule has no conditions and will never match

fields.toolsAllowHint: Tool name globs (e.g. web_*). If set, only matching tools may be called.
fields.toolsDenyHint: Tool name globs that may never be called. Deny always wins.
fields.mcpAllowHint: MCP server name globs. If set, only tools from matching servers may be called.
fields.mcpDenyHint: MCP server name globs whose tools may never be called. Deny always wins.
fields.personaHint: Overrides the persona for matching senders.
fields.modelHint: Overrides the Codex model for matching senders. Leave empty to use the default.
fields.modelCacheWarning: Switching the model mid-thread discards the prompt cache, so the next turn costs more.
fields.nativeExecHint: Only matters when native Codex exec tools are enabled.
fields.globalMemoryHint: Whether this sender's private chats may write to the global memory store (only when Codex memories are enabled).

tester.title: Test a sender
tester.subtitle: Check which rule applies to a sender using the rules as currently edited (unsaved changes included).
tester.noMatch: No rule matches; the default (unrestricted) policy applies.

messages.unsavedChangesLeaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?
messages.invalidConditionsConfirm: Some enabled rules have conditions that will never match. Save anyway?
